items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: We was there too. We were all band and played.

ctx.x: But he's still playing. He... Last time I heard him play was in... The Jazz Festival they had two years ago in South Sweden. Conk Bates was there and Niklas was there. Mm-hm. He was playing there then. That was the last time I heard his band. We was there too. We were all band and played. It was a Danish band, you know, kind of band from all over the world.
Who was the Danish band? Yeah.
